stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Brenda Nguyen is the competition leader on 28 pts, the one card everybody else is measuring themselves against.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace with 5 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Lovely to have Michael Leary from Wagga City GC out on the course with us today.

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 9 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Pristine
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 14 holes - the scorer has not written a zero yet

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 4 threes and 3 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: The Closer
stories.detail: Saved the best for last - 9 coming home over the final three

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 6 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 6 straight two-pointers on holes 13-18

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 14-17 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - drama then redemption

stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 4 & 5 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 14 & 15

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 11-14 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 14, 3-pointer on hole 15 - that's better

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 11-14

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 9 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Technical Difficulties
stories.detail: 3 wipes on holes 14, 15 & 16 - please stand by

stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12

stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - sticking to the 1-point script
